$sources: Daylight: the average daylight factor formula of BRE 'Site layout planning for daylight and sunlight' (BR 209) Appendix C and CIBSE LG10 (Littlefair's form); the transmittance, maintenance and reflectance values are typical values of those guides, SAEngine practice defaults, editable per project

Road noise: the form of the UK Calculation of Road Traffic Noise (CRTN, Department of Transport, 1988), Charts 3, 4, 6 and 7 and the facade correction; indicative facade levels only, not a noise assessment

sources.transmittance: SAEngine practice: clear double glazing, about 0.68 diffuse (BR 209 Appendix C / CIBSE LG10 typical value)
sources.maintenance: SAEngine practice: 0.9, glazing cleaned regularly, not sloped (CIBSE LG10 typical value)
sources.reflectance: SAEngine practice: 0.5, area-weighted mean of light-coloured rooms (BR 209 Appendix C typical value)
sources.frameShare: SAEngine practice: 20 % of a window's opening is frame
sources.skyAngle: Visible sky angle of an unobstructed vertical window [degrees] (BR 209 Appendix C)

sources.basic: CRTN Chart 3 (Eq 4): L10(18-hour) = 29.1 + 10 log10 Q, Q the 18-hour (06:00-24:00) flow
sources.gradientPerPercent: CRTN Chart 6 (Eq 6): +0.3 G dB(A) for a gradient of G %
sources.referenceDistance: CRTN Chart 7 (Eq 7): -10 log10(d'/13.5), d' the slant distance from the source line 3.5 m from the near kerb, 0.5 m high
sources.facade: CRTN: +2.5 dB(A) at 1 m in front of a facade (reflection)
sources.l10ToLaeq: SAEngine practice: LAeq,18h is about L10,18h - 2 dB (an often-used rule of thumb), shown for orientation only
